item.text:
Added several independent source families for 1B, with a clearer split between policy intent, implementation, and contrary assessments.

What improved:
- `Bundestag` oversight material now anchors the 2023 implementation side of the F-35 / nuclear-sharing decision.
- `SIPRI` now provides an independent analytical frame on umbrella states and the tension between alliance commitments and disarmament norms.
- `ICAN` provides explicit contrary evidence that nuclear sharing undermines the NPT/TPNW framework.
- The `Bundestag` hearing on global disarmament architecture adds independent expert warnings on escalation, AI, and the credibility/failure tradeoff.
- The `CTBTO` and `Bundestag` materials give a cleaner baseline for CTBT/NCBT posture and Germany’s formal position.

Most useful new sources and locators:
- [Bundestag hearing on global disarmament architecture](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw19-pa-ua-abruestung-946014#L8) at lines 8-45.
- [Bundestag 2023 defense budget shift showing F-35 funding](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-920662) at the F-35 / Luft dimension paragraph.
- [Bundestag answer on nuclear sharing and NPT](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1023028) at lines 6-9.
- [SIPRI umbrella states paper](https://www.sipri.org/publications/2023/sipri-insights-peace-and-security/role-umbrella-states-global-nuclear-order) at lines 78-80.
- [ICAN statement on nuclear sharing](https://www.icanw.de/neuigkeiten/npt23-ican-erklaerung-zur-nuklearen-teilhabe/) at lines 79-85 and 87-91.
- [CTBTO Article XIV conference 2023](https://www.ctbto.org/our-mission/article-xiv-conferences/2023-conference-facilitating-entry-force-comprehensive-nuclear) for the treaty-process baseline.
- [Foreign Office 2023 disarmament report](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/aussenpolitik/annual-disarmament-report-2653268) at lines 97-113.
